notes: Added: · Subtle sounds now follow you around the editor: controls whisper on hover, dropdown menus tick once per row as you arrow through them, sidebar sections chirp when opened or closed, and drop zones sweep when a file arms them and buzz when they refuse one. Everything stays quiet under "reduce motion" and while typing. · Changed: · A section with a custom colour now carries that colour through its controls, not just its stripe: the outlines of its secondary buttons ("+ Attach image", "Choose…"), its text inputs at rest and on focus, its profile rows at rest and on hover, the ring that marks the drop target while you drag-reorder sections, and the dragged card itself, which glows in its own colour so it stays identifiable against the boxes it passes over. · Fixed: · "Continue last session" on the home screen now actually continues when the session was saved from the home screen itself: it opens the editor instead of silently re-showing the home screen, and its subtitle names the page it will open. · Profiles rows in the editor sidebar no longer clip their Delete action off the panel edge — row actions (rename, update, remove cover, delete) are compact icons instead of text buttons. · A profile whose cover image or video file went missing now falls back to the default artwork instead of showing a blank box.
